test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Vikas took a bus from a bus stop. The bus travelled 50 m towards the west. Then, it took a right turn and travelled 70 m. Then, it took a left turn and travelled 15 m. Then, it took a left turn and travelled 30 m. Then, it took a left turn and travelled 35 m. Then, it took a right turn and travelled 10 m. Finally, it took a left turn and travelled 30 m to reach the school. How far and in which direction is the bus stop from the school? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Drawing the diagram according to the given information,

 
• Vikas took a bus from a bus stop. The bus traveled 50 m towards the west. 
 
• Then, it took a right turn and traveled 70 m. 
 
• Then, it took a left turn and traveled 15 m. 
 
• Then, it took a left turn and traveled 30 m. 
 
• Then, it took a left turn and traveled 35 m.
